page.overview:
What is Netsu Netsu no Mi?

The Netsu Netsu no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to emanate heat from their body, making the user a . It was eaten by Charlotte Oven.

The user is capable of heating parts of their body to temperatures greater than most people can withstand, thus increasing the damage they can do with their melee attack, or even simply by touching their opponent. The user can transfer the heat to other objects as well, such as super heating a weapon they wield in order to increase its attack power. The user can also transfer heat to the sea itself, creating a dangerous hazard zone for enemy ships, and even more so for enemies swimming in the water.

Additionally, the user can transfer heat into their opponent's weapon will make it too hot for them to wield. This transfer of heat can even happen without physical contact, as demonstrated when Oven seemingly projected heat energy to set a gun ablaze.

However, this power is mostly ineffective against opponents who possess a resistance to heat. Other than that, the user is also affected by the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.
